references.text: Here it is described how God heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds, which resembles how Jesus healed the sick in Matthew 15:30.
This passage predicts the healing of the blind and lame, parallel to what happens in Matthew 15:30.
Jesus refers to healings as signs of His messianic mission, including the healing of the blind and lame, which aligns with the events in Matthew 15:30.
Jesus tells John the Baptist's disciples about the miracles He performs, which include healing the blind and lame, parallel to Matthew 15:30.
